propositions: The AC1 cross-surface equivalence contract re-calls compose_operation_snapshot identically across MCP, reconciler, and Python blocks rather than driving real entry points, making the test vacuously true even if the actual surfaces stop routing through the shared composer

The test must invoke the real MCP entry point via build_server() and call_tool(), and the real reconciler entry point via rebar_reconciler.__main__.main() with argv, capturing snapshots through runtime rebinding of the module-global compose_operation_snapshot

Each surface block must anchor its snapshot to absolute expected content (repo root, envelope version, config keys) in addition to cross-surface comparison, and must fail with an explicit message if its surface composes no snapshot
Perturbing the composer to collapse env provenance into project must cause the MCP and reconciler surface assertions to fail RED while the pre-change version stays GREEN under the same perturbation
Neutralizing the MCP _shadow body or reconciler _emit_operation_shadow body independently must cause that surface's assertion to fail RED naming the surface
